title: Finite level majority Fourier weight bound
statement: Let $n$ and $j$ be nonnegative integers, with $n$ odd and $2j<n$. The Fourier weight of the majority function on $n$ signs at level $j$, minus the limiting majority Fourier weight at level $j$, is at most $\frac{2j}{n}$ times that limiting weight.
